Fixers are data-correction steps chained per table in a pipeline's `fixer_configs.py`. A *generic* fixer works on any CDM; a CDM-scoped fixer only on that CDM. Guide: [Fixer chains](../06-authoring/fixers.md).

## generic

| Fixer | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `append_to_existing_lds_address_hx` | Append existing LDS address history from Snowflake to the current batch. |
| `copy_admit_date_or_delete` | Backfill null date fields with ADMIT_DATE from the encounter table. |
| `copy_when_null` | Copy a source column value into the target column when the target is null. |
| `delete_records_after_death` | Remove records whose date field is later than the patient's death date. |
| `delete_records_before_birth` | Remove records whose date field is earlier than the patient's birth date. |
| `delete_when_null` | Remove rows where a specified field is null. |
| `encounterid_orphans` | Null out ENCOUNTERID values that have no match in the encounter table. |
| `future_date_to_null` | Null out date values that fall after the harvest refresh date. |
| `illogical_admit_date` | Replace date values that are more than 5 days before ADMIT_DATE. |
| `illogical_discharge_date` | Replace date values that are more than 5 days after DISCHARGE_DATE. |
| `invalid_to_null` | Remove rows where the specified field is null. |
| `list_remover` | Remove rows whose column value is present in a reference list. |
| `norm_range_normalization` | Normalize NORM_RANGE and NORM_MODIFIER fields in lab_result_cm. |
| `patid_orphans` | Remove rows whose PATID is not present in a reference table. |
| `patterns_remover` | Remove rows where a column matches any pattern from a reference list. |
| `providerid_orphans` | Null out provider ID values that have no match in the provider table. |
| `replication` | Copy ADMIT_DATE and ENC_TYPE from the encounter table into the main table. |

## pcornet_7_0

| Fixer | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `add_missing_hash_token_patids` | Add stub hash_token rows for PATIDs that exist in demographic but not hash_token. |
| `delete_when_null_or_fon` | Remove rows where a specified field is null, empty, or a flavor of null. |
| `loinc_mover` | Remove rows whose LOINC code belongs in a different CDM table. |
| `null_date_to_harvest_refresh` | Backfill null date values with the corresponding harvest refresh date. |
| `panel_loinc_remover` | Remove rows with panel-type LOINC codes from the DataFrame. |
| `race_eth` | Derive seven RACE_ETH_* columns from RACE and HISPANIC values. |
